business_summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides a range of banking and financial products and services for retail and commercial customers in the United Kingdom. It operates in three segments: Retail; Commercial Banking; and Insurance, Pensions and Investments. The Retail segment offers a range of financial service products, including current accounts, savings, mortgages, credit cards, unsecured loans, motor finance, and leasing solutions to personal customers. Its Commercial Banking segment provides lending, transactional banking, working capital management, debt financing, and risk management services to small and medium businesses, corporates, and institutions. The Insurance, Pensions and Investments segment offers insurance, investment, and pension management products and services. It also provides life assurance; and digital banking services. The company offers its products and services under the Lloyds Bank, Halifax, Bank of Scotland, Scottish Widows, MBNA, Schroders Personal Wealth, Black Horse, Lex Autolease, Birmingham Midshires, LDC, AMC, Embark Group, Lloyds Living, Cavendish Online, Tusker, and HGP brands. The company was formerly known as Lloyds TSB Group plc and changed its name to Lloyds Banking Group plc in January 2009. Lloyds Banking Group plc was founded in 1695 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
business_summary_ko: Lloyds Banking Group plc는 자회사와 함께 영국의 소매 및 상업 고객에게 다양한 은행 및 금융 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 그것은 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다: 소매; 상업 은행; 보험, 연금 및 투자. 소매 부문은 당좌예금, 저축, 모기지, 신용카드, 무담보 대출, 자동차 금융 및 개인 고객을 위한 임대 솔루션을 포함한 다양한 금융 서비스 상품을 제공합니다. 상업 은행 부문은 중소기업, 기업 및 기관에 대출, 거래 은행, 운전 자본 관리, 부채 자금 조달 및 위험 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 보험, 연금 및 투자 부문은 보험, 투자, 연금 관리 상품 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 생명 보장을 제공합니다. 디지털 뱅킹 서비스. 회사는 Lloyds Bank, Halifax, Bank of Scotland, Scottish Widows, MBNA, Schroders Personal Wealth, Black Horse, Lex Autolease, Birmingham Midshires, LDC, AMC, Embark Group, Lloyds Living, Cavendish Online, Tusker 및 HGP 브랜드로 제품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Lloyds TSB로 알려졌습니다.
